verdict.rationale: AvaTax has a documented public REST v2 API. First-party docs cover individual endpoints such as CreateTransaction and CreateNexus, an interactive API Explorer listing parameters, authentication and responses, official SDKs in six languages, and free-trial access with no credit card. An llms.txt also exists for agent discovery. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
